# dsh-census
Plugin census for DeepSeek Harness: **what is loaded, what it costs, what collides** — in one read-o
for DeepSeek Harness: **what is loaded, what it costs, what collides** — in one read-only tool call.
Community plugins add real capability, but nothing tells you what each one charges against your cont
ext window, whether two of them collide, or whether they still declare the harness version they were
built against. Census answers those three questions deterministically, without mutating anything.

## The `census` tool
One tool, one call, no prompt-section overhead. The report contains:
- **Inventory** — every loader entry (id, module specifier, enablement, fiber phase) with the same p
rojection semantics as the official `pluginInventory/list` Remote; failed entries surface as errors,

not silence.
- **Findings** — failed entries, relative specifiers (repository plugins require absol
ute paths), duplicate system-prompt section names in one assembly, patch rows addressed by more than
one layer (patches replace a row's whole config — last write wins), and third-party plugins whose d

eclared dsh target does not match the running harness.
- **Context suffix cost** — per-section and p
er-tool-schema token estimates for one assembly (fixed 4-chars-per-token heuristic), plus the share
of the resolved context window when the model route advertises one.
Pass `verbose: true` for per-entry inventory and per-module compat tables.
## Scope and non-goals
- **Read-only** — census never enables, disables, patches, or repairs anything. Recovery flows alrea

dy exist elsewhere (`dsh-doctor`); census deliberately does not compete with them.
- **Host-side onl
y in 0.1** — client-UI mount-path conflicts live in browser-land and need a client half; not covered

yet.
- **Heuristic cost** — the estimator mirrors the official `dsh-token-meter` fixed heuristic (4
chars/token) and inherits its documented weakness: CJK text and JSON schemas underprice badly. Trea
t every figure as an estimate.
## Model Experience
None. Census registers exactly one tool (`census`) and contributes no sections, contexts, or prompt
text of its own. Its output reaches the model only when a call is made.
## KV Cache effect
The tool's own schema is a single short entry. Calling `census` appends one tool result to the sessi
on surface; it registers no durable messages and no runtime contexts. The report's purpose is to mak
e **other** plugins' KV-cache cost visible: per-section and per-tool token estimates quantify exactl
y how much suffix each plugin's prompt contribution adds on every request.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The integration test boots a real `@deepseek-ai/cordis` context, loads the official `dsh-system-prom
pt` and `dsh-tools` plugins, registers census, and executes it through the real tool pipeline.
